name: CalVet Benefits & Services Portal
description: Free benefits information and navigation for California veterans and families; access to CalVet home loans, college fee waivers, veterans homes, and employment services
fullDescription: The California Department of Veterans Affairs (CalVet) connects California veterans and their families with their earned state and federal benefits through education, advocacy, and direct services. The CalVet website helps veterans find housing, education, employment, healthcare, and financial assistance.
whatTheyOffer:
- myCalVet profile for customized benefits and services information
- Home loans with competitive rates (CalVet Home Loans)
- College fee waivers for dependents (CalVet College Fee Waiver)
- Veterans Homes of California (8 locations statewide)
- Employment and transition services
- Help with VA claims through County Veterans Service Offices (CVSOs)
- Mental health and wellness resources
- Veteran designation on driver licenses and ID cards
howToGetIt:
1. Visit calvet.ca.gov or call CalVet toll-free
2. Create a myCalVet profile to get customized benefits information
3. Find your local County Veterans Service Office (CVSO) at 1-844-737-8838 (1-844-SERV-VET) for free in-person help with claims and applications
4. Apply for the specific programs you qualify for
keywords: CalVet, veteran benefits, California veteran, VA benefits, home loan, college fee waiver, veterans home, employment, claims assistance
